For the first time ever, ChatGPT no longer holds majority market share in AI.

Sensor Tower's State of AI Report, covered by TechCrunch this week, puts the numbers in sharp relief: ChatGPT is below 50%. Google Gemini has climbed to 27.7%. Anthropic's Claude holds 10.3%.

This matters beyond the headline. For business leaders who built their AI initiatives around a single platform, this is the moment to rethink that approach. The market has fragmented — and it is not going back.

Google is embedding Gemini across its entire ecosystem: Android, Search, smart home devices, and Cloud infrastructure. Anthropic is carving out trusted positions in coding and safety-sensitive enterprise use cases. The result is a competitive landscape where no single provider has a durable monopoly on capability.

The executive response should not be to chase the next frontrunner. It should be to build AI architectures that are model-agnostic — systems designed to leverage the best tool for each job without locking your organization into a single vendor's roadmap.
